entries.text: What do the Paladins do?

entries.text: Stuff? I could teach you how to fight...if you had any ability. But the High Elder decreed no training of new recruits until the threat of invasion passes.

entries.text: Possibly. When the invading army is vanquished, come back to be trained.

entries.text: Yes. Can I ask you a few more questions?

entries.text: Many covet our technology. We have at least four attacks a week, from raiders to just people who want to steal what we have.
